SASKATCHEWAN COMPLAINT BRIEFS

Open index.html for all 28 concerns. Each SK-Cxxx.pdf, .html, .txt and .json includes the complete concern and evidence. HTML files include their own PDF download and work independently of the dashboard.

SK-C identifies a grouped concern; SK-E identifies an evidence record. They are permanent internal references, not official government case numbers.

Source snapshot: 2026-11-25. Review window: 2024-11-25 to 2026-11-25.
50 distinct public accounts and 25 named people in reporting are separate counts and may overlap. Accounts are not verified individuals. Platform gaps and date limits are labelled.

Public dashboard: https://saskatchewan-service-complaints.soomrozaid.chatgpt.site
